title: Small representatives of bounded coherent cocones
statement: Use the nested universes, smallness and $\kappa$-small simplicial sets of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and the quasicategories, coherent cocones and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ be an infinite regular cardinal and let $C$ be a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory. There is a $\mathcal U$-small family of triples $(K_r,a_r,\lambda_r)$, where $K_r$ is a $\kappa$-small simplicial set, $a_r\in C$, and $\lambda_r:p_r\to\Delta_{K_r}a_r$ is a coherent cocone in $C$, with the following property. For every $\kappa$-small simplicial set $K$ and every coherent cocone $\lambda:p\to\Delta_Ka$ in $C$, there exist $r$ and an isomorphism of simplicial sets $u:K_r\cong K$ such that $a_r=a$ and $\lambda_r=u^*\lambda$ as coherent cocone data (so $p_r=pu$). The subfamily of colimiting cocones is small and represents every colimiting cocone in this same sense. Empty bases are included. No existence of colimits in $C$ is assumed.

source.place: HTT Proposition 5.3.6.2, proof, printed p. 413, smallness reduction for the collection R; Definition 5.3.6.5 and Example 5.3.6.8, p. 415, use all bounded colimiting cocones. The bounded-shape counting argument needed here is stated separately, not asserted to be the verbatim proposition. Agent-formulated auxiliary consequence; read the April 9, 2017 HTT text online. Not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical assertion.
